title: Share Your Live Location
description: Always share your live location with at least one trusted contact when traveling alone or at night.

title: Avoid Posting Real-Time Locations
description: Do not post your current location on social media. Wait until you have left the place before sharing.

title: Use Safe Routes
description: Choose well-lit and busy routes. Avoid isolated roads and shortcuts, especially after dark.

title: Teach Children Code Words
description: Create a secret family code word that only trusted adults know. Teach children never to go with anyone who doesn't know it.

title: Keep Emergency Numbers Ready
description: Save police, emergency, and trusted contact numbers on speed dial and on a piece of paper in your wallet.

title: Travel in Groups
description: Whenever possible, travel with other people. There is safety in numbers.

title: Be Aware of Your Surroundings
description: Avoid using headphones at high volume or being deeply focused on your phone when walking alone.

title: Verify Identities
description: Always verify the identity of anyone claiming to be from school, delivery, or government before opening the door.

title: Use Trusted Transport
description: Prefer registered ride-hailing services or known drivers. Share the trip details with a friend.

title: Community Watch Groups
description: Join or form local community safety groups to share information and support each other.

title: Secure Your Home
description: Install good locks, outdoor lighting, and consider a simple alarm or camera system.

title: Plan Your Journey
description: Tell someone your destination, expected arrival time, and the route you plan to take.

title: Trust Your Instincts
description: If a situation or person feels wrong, leave immediately. Your intuition is a powerful safety tool.

title: Educate Your Family
description: Regularly discuss safety rules with children and household members so everyone knows what to do.

title: Report Suspicious Activity
description: Report unusual behavior or abandoned vehicles to local security or community leaders quickly.

title: Keep Doors Locked
description: Always lock car doors while driving and home doors even when you are inside.

title: Avoid Isolated ATMs
description: Use ATMs in busy, well-lit areas during the day whenever possible.

title: Emergency Meeting Point
description: Agree on a safe meeting place for the family in case of an emergency or separation.
